body:
I used a scale exact to 0.004mg and weigh out 10mg  and divide that into the 4 parts.
Smoking one portion of this is like good weed, red eyes, sleepy, laughing, hunger (appetite). I can imagine doubling that dose to be a bit too much. It takes a few seconds to take effect and lasts about an hour and then slowly gets less powerful over about 45 minutes.
